project.name: CareConnect EHR Identity Reconciliation
project.description:
Shared reconciliation pattern for EHR identity conflicts (ehr_source_identity vs. patient). One correctness-critical implementation, adopted by every adapter team (athenahealth, Epic, Oracle Health, and Medicare's eventual sibling implementation), instead of four independent reimplementations of the same conditional/timestamp-guarded write.
Scope: demographic/identity fields only (name, address, phone, DOB, etc. on ehr_source_identity vs. patient). Does NOT cover FR-EHR-07 medication conflicts (which must be flagged for caregiver review, never auto-resolved) or FR-XSRC-03/04 visit/claims delta-flagging (a different, separate reconciliation problem). See README.md.
